content:
anya: quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC discussion: we need a pragmatic decision on attr retention vs per-tenant streams. short takes please.

mike: eviction+slimming is cheapest. per-tenant streams are the most accurate but add ops overhead.

tariq: we've already seen billing.customer_id disappear from a handful of traces after aggressive trimming. that's a real support risk.

lucy: noisy tenants with huge cardinality also blow up our query latencies. dedicated streams contain the blast radius.

anya: ops concern 11 partitioning = many more shards + autoscale complexity. can't let that explode without caps.

mike: hybrid: pin a tiny required attr set at the gateway, slim other attrs, and fanout (write-full) for detected noisy tenants for a window.

tariq: detection needs to be stable and cheap. suggest a 5m sliding window using unique-attr growth + TPS. add cooldown to avoid flapping.

lucy: also add a safelist for enterprise customers who always get full fidelity. retention/keys must be managed for tenant streams.

anya: gateway config sketch: pinned=["billing.customer_id","tenant.id","service.name"], max_extra=25, missing_policy=flag; fanout.threshold={tps:1000, unique_growth:500/min}, fanout.cooldown=30m, fanout.max_dedicated=30.

mike: fanout semantics: write both slimmed main stream + full tenant stream. query layer prefers tenant stream if present; admin dashboards can do fanout+merge. avoid cross-partition joins for SLO paths.

tariq: spike plan: synth 200 tenants, inject 5 noisy; measure write amplification, cost delta, and check attribution_loss. prototype detector + cooldown.

ingest-bot: spike task created by @anya -> PHAB-OBS-721 (https://phab.redwood/OBS-721).

anya: owners: mike+tariq run 4d spike, lucy craft attribution evals & dashboard. I'll update the RFC with hybrid-fanout recommendation after numbers.

lucy: I'll include a prompt/eval set to measure false negatives for billing attribution and surface per-tenant attribution_loss.

mike: acked. will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
